# Mirayi Sdn Bhd (Mirayi Animation Studio)

> Malaysian 3D animation and IP development studio, founded in 2005. Mirayi produces game cinematics, animated TV series, feature-film animation and TV commercials for clients in the U.S., Europe and Asia, and develops its own original animated IP. MSC Malaysia status; licensed by FINAS. Eligible projects can use the Film in Malaysia Incentive (FIMI) 30% cash rebate.

Original IP: Neon Luna, Red & Wolf, Mask Masters S-01, MegaBear, Mask Masters S-02, Toby n Friends.

## Pages

- [About Mirayi](https://www.mirayi.my/whoweare): Mirayi is a Malaysian 3D animation and IP development studio founded in 2005, with MSC Malaysia status and a FINAS licence. Meet the team.
- [Our business and services](https://www.mirayi.my/ourbusiness): Animation services from Mirayi in Malaysia: pre-production, 3D production and post-production for game cinematics, series, films and commercials.
- [Our original IP](https://www.mirayi.my/mirayibrand): Original animated IP from Mirayi: Neon Luna, Red & Wolf, Mask Masters, MegaBear and Toby n Friends. Explore our series and co-production opportunities.
- [Production portfolio](https://www.mirayi.my/production): Portfolio of game cinematics, animated series, feature film animation and TV commercials produced by Mirayi for international studios.
- [Animated series and feature film](https://www.mirayi.my/seriesandfilms): TV series and feature film animation by Mirayi in Malaysia: episodic production for broadcasters and studios in the U.S., Europe and Asia.
- [Game animation services](https://www.mirayi.my/gameproduction): Game animation services from Mirayi: cinematics, in-engine cutscenes (Unreal, Unity), gameplay animation, game assets and rigging.
- [TV commercial animation](https://www.mirayi.my/tvcommercials): Animated TV commercials from Mirayi: cinematic 3D animation for brands and game publishers in the U.S., Europe and Asia.
- [Visual development and concept art](https://www.mirayi.my/visualdevelopment): Visual development and concept art for games, animation and original IP: characters, environments and style frames by Mirayi's artists.
- [Blog](https://www.mirayi.my/blog): Animation tips, industry news and behind-the-scenes stories from Mirayi, for game producers, filmmakers and creative directors.
- [Careers](https://www.mirayi.my/join-with-us): Join Mirayi, a Malaysian animation studio. See open roles and apply to our creative team of animators and artists.
